title: Printable Venn diagram templates
subject: Mathematics
source: Seeded from mathematics/y9 lesson 84 (Printable Venn diagram templates)
intro: Lesson 84: Venn diagrams and probability. To understand how to use Venn diagrams and set notation to find probabilities, including 'given that' questions

blocks.text: Draw a rectangle round both circles for the universal set ξ.

picture.draw: Draw and label: Printable Venn diagram templates

questions.q: ξ = 60 pupils. 35 study Arabic (A), 25 study Urdu (U), 12 study both. Draw the diagram; find P(A ∩ U), P(A ∪ U), P(U′), P(A given U).
questions.model: Put 12 in the middle; A only = 35 - 12 = 23; U only = 25 - 12 = 13; neither = 60 - 48 = 12.

questions.q: Show that P(A ∪ U) = P(A) + P(U) - P(A ∩ U) with these numbers.
In a 3-set Venn diagram, explain why you fill the centre (all three) first.
questions.a: Every other region is found by subtracting from the totals, which include the centre
A) in A or B or both
options: in A or B or both

questions.q: Big question: how do Venn diagrams help?
questions.a: Each region is a count; probabilities are regions over the right total.
